goldens_sim_key.reason: the sim key serialises the whole SimConfig, and the slice frame now records the tilt map and the angles as set (TASK-M6-48: a view saved before them reads as Lean each axis at 0); at the goldens' frame they are Tip as sheet at 0 and 0. A difference by design, listed in TASK-M6-48's PR; accepted by the owner, 24 Nov 2026: "accept"
